I'll create credentials for BrightCart and email the keys to the primary contact (Alyssa) 10 minutes before the call via a one-time secure link. - 5m intro + goal alignment
- 10–15m live walkthrough of Hosted API (sample prompts, streaming, function calls)
- 10m short load/latency expectations + token-cost walkthrough in Console
- 5–10m sandbox creds & next steps (MVP rollout plan)
